name: pressable
title: Pressable
description: Clickable surface for a card, row, or list item. A real button, so keyboard activation and the accessible name come from the platform.
docs: Renders a real button for a clickable card, row, or list item, so Enter, Space, focus, and the accessible name come from the platform instead of a div with an onClick. Uses the subtle press scale: the standard control press scale reads as a layout bug across a full-width surface. See DESIGN.md.
